applied.fact: Schedule credits an 11-hr on-route time to the first ascent

days.note: One of the hardest multi-pitch free routes in Washington. The first ascent (Schaefer/Lee, Aug 2019) topped out the tenth and final pitch late in the day. Most parties rappel the route on a single 80m rope rather than finishing the 4th-class scramble to the true summit.
days.title: Very long single day

schedule.label: Top out / begin rappels
schedule.detail: ~11 hrs on route, per the FA timing

itinerary.totalNote: A single very long day for the rare parties capable of it: roughly 12-13 hrs car-to-car including approach and rappel descent.
